item.text: I can’t reliably certify a maximum-point schedule for this many interdependent time-window, travel, team, and lunch constraints by hand. I don’t want to present a merely feasible schedule as optimal. A solver or spreadsheet model would be needed to verify the maximum and produce the requested CSV.
